supersession_reason: v1's E1 and E2 required every named tile (25,27,28,29 for E1; 25,27,21,22,23 for E2) to be present at a locus before scoring it. Tile eligibility varies by locus, so this collapsed the development cohort to n=34 (E1) and n=22 (E2), and E1's development 95% CI spanned zero (+0.1419, [-0.1009, +0.4074]). No confirmation-split outcome had been read when this was found; v2 relaxes the completeness rule and adds E1b before any confirmation endpoint opens.

scope.question: Is the D8 mask profile a bounded downstream domain with a distal edge and a TSS polarity reversal, rather than a single 10-nt tile?
scope.basis: Exploratory re-aggregation of the frozen D8 development per-locus records. Tiles 25/26/27 each clear both D8 SESOIs with positive lower bounds; only tile 26 cleared the 60-test family correction.
scope.licensed_if_qualified: a replicated bounded classifier-relevant downstream source domain and a replicated TSS-relative polarity in mask sensitivity

cohort.reuse_boundary: The confirmation split is reused. Only mask|tile26 has ever been opened on it. E1-E3 use tiles never opened; E4 is descriptive because it includes tile 26.

E1_downstream_edge.definition: per locus: mean(target_specific_loss over tiles 25,27) minus mean over tiles 28,29
E1_downstream_edge.completeness_rule: at least one inner tile and at least one outer tile present; average over whichever are available

E1b_sharp_edge.definition: per locus: target_specific_loss at tile 27 minus target_specific_loss at tile 28
E1b_sharp_edge.completeness_rule: both tiles required; loci missing either tile are not scored
E1b_sharp_edge.note: the sharpest statement of the +31 nt boundary; needs only two tiles per locus, so it is not subject to E1's inner/outer averaging

E2_tss_polarity.definition: per locus: mean(target_specific_loss over tiles 25,27) minus mean over tiles 21,22,23
E2_tss_polarity.completeness_rule: at least one inner tile and at least one outer tile present; average over whichever are available

E4_full_domain.definition: per locus: mean(target_specific_loss over tiles 25,26,27) minus mean over tiles 28,29
E4_full_domain.reason: includes tile 26, whose confirmation value was opened by D8

M1_identity.check: a no-op intervention (zero tokens replaced) yields target_specific_loss with maximum absolute value below tolerance

M2_record_anchor.check: re-scoring the unchanged mask|tile26 confirmation test reproduces EVERY recorded per-example target_specific_loss
M2_record_anchor.verified_achievable: worst absolute difference 4.3e-06 on a 6-row spot check under the pinned environment

M3_cover_balance.check: for every scored tile-locus, abs(target cover length minus control cover length) is at most 2 nt

M4_equal_dose.check: every scored tile masks exactly 2 genomic tokens on each branch

inference.multiplicity: Holm across E1, E1b, E2, E3

split_gate.confirmation_opens_if: all four memorials pass and the frozen development prediction file exists with a recorded SHA-256
qualification_requires: point estimate meets the endpoint SESOI
95% locus-block bootstrap interval excludes zero on the alternative side
Holm-adjusted add-one sign-flip p at most 0.05
confirmation sign matches the frozen development prediction

stop_rules: If M1 or M2 fails, record INSTRUMENT_UNRESOLVED and open no confirmation endpoint.
If E1 and E2 both fail, the domain claim is not supported; do not run Phase H.
Failure of E3 licenses no null: it is powered only for effects at or above 0.10 absolute.
